definitions.short: Eloth or Elath , a place on the Red Sea
definitions.full: H359. Eloth אֵילַת proper name, of a location ( lofty tree ( s collective?) i.e. palms? compare Di Gen 14:6 ) town & harbour, northeast arm of Red Sea, hence called lanitic Gulf (= Gulf of Akaba, from neighbouring fortress) Deut 2:8 ; 2Kin 14:22 ; 16:6 (twice in verse) (perhaps later designation for fuller פארן איל q. v.) = ᵐ5 Αἰλων , Αἰλαθ Greek Αἰλανα etc.; = אֵלָה (? Gen 36:41 see Di), אֵילוֺת below אֵילוֺת proper name, of a location id. ( grove of lofty trees (palms?)) 1Kin 9:26 ; 2Kin 16:6 ; 2Chr 8:17 ; 26:2 (compare אֵילַת מָּאוָן, אֵיל ).
definitions.rootNote: or אֵילַת ; from 352 ; trees or a grove (i.e. palms);
